purpose: Behavioral acceptance briefs; run against an actual agent. These are not audio benchmarks.
scoring: Pass only when all must-do and must-not-do conditions are met. Record the actual output, model, date, tool access, and reviewer decision.

cases.name: Country detail without props
cases.prompt: Write a country verse about returning to a partner after always leaving during arguments, without trucks or alcohol.

cases.name: Grungegrass lens
cases.prompt: Write a grungegrass chorus about admitting fear, not a song about drinking or roads.

cases.name: Distinct duet agency
cases.prompt: Write a duet where both people contributed to a falling-out and neither is merely the comforting partner.
must_do: Clear ownership and converging shared lines
must_not_do: Female co-lead only echoes male lead

cases.name: Melody unavailable
cases.prompt: Polish this long verse while keeping its existing melody. No audio or notation has been provided.
must_not_do: Guarantee drop-in fit from syllable count

cases.name: Locked chorus
cases.prompt: Keep my approved chorus exactly; revise only verse two and show a short change log.

cases.name: Rap prosody
cases.prompt: Create a 16-bar rap verse with internal rhyme and clear breath groups, without imitating a named rapper.
must_do: No stolen or invented autobiographical credentials
must_not_do: Dense syntax with no performance room

cases.name: Dance minimalism
cases.prompt: Write a minimal vocal hook for an instrumental-led house track; no full narrative verses.

cases.name: Multilingual lyric
cases.prompt: Write a Japanese/English refrain. Preserve native script and put pronunciation help separately.

cases.name: Lullaby dynamics
cases.prompt: Write a reassuring bedtime song for a young child with no big final chorus or frightening imagery.

cases.name: Biographical humility
cases.prompt: Use a cassette-player image for a fictional 1990s narrator, but do not claim this happened to me.
must_do: Label invented scene as fictional when explaining
Use era detail with narrative function
must_not_do: Describe imagined event as user history

cases.name: Metaphor audit
cases.prompt: Critique a rain-and-drought reconciliation lyric; improve only accidental confusion, not the central metaphor.
must_do: No broad rewrite for its own sake
must_not_do: Treat every unconventional metaphor as an error

cases.name: Trigger boundary
cases.prompt: Explain how to configure a guitar compressor; I am not writing lyrics.
must_do: Do not activate lyric workflow as the main task
